description:
The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is a significant welfare scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India.

The scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2018.

It aims to provide financial assistance to pregnant women during their pregnancy and childbirth.

The primary objective of the Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is to reduce maternal and infant mortality rates.

The scheme also aims to encourage institutional deliveries among pregnant women.

The government has set a target to increase the percentage of institutional deliveries to at least 90 percent by the year 2025.

Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive a financial assistance of ₹16,000.

This amount is disbursed in two installments.

The first installment of ₹6,000 is provided during the registration of pregnancy.

The second installment of ₹10,000 is provided after the delivery of the child.

The assistance is aimed at covering the medical expenses related to pregnancy and childbirth.

Eligibility for the Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is defined by specific criteria.

Beneficiaries must be residents of Madhya Pradesh.

They must be pregnant women who are above the age of 18 years.

The scheme is applicable to women who are undergoing their first or second childbirth.

Women who have a family income of less than ₹2 lakh per annum are eligible for this scheme.

The application process for the Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is straightforward.

Pregnant women must first register their pregnancy at the nearest health center.

They need to provide proof of pregnancy through a medical certificate.

The required documents include an Aadhar card for identity verification.

They must also submit a copy of the income certificate to prove eligibility.

Once the documents are submitted, the health center will verify the information.

After verification, the first installment of ₹6,000 will be disbursed.

The second installment of ₹10,000 is provided after the delivery.

This is contingent upon the woman delivering in a government-approved health facility.

The timeline for the disbursement of funds is as follows.

The first installment is typically disbursed within 30 days of registration.

The second installment is disbursed within 30 days after the delivery.

The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development in Madhya Pradesh.

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and fund disbursement.

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the department at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is 181.

The scheme has seen a significant uptake since its launch.

As of 2023, over 1.5 million women have benefited from the scheme.

The Madhya Pradesh government has allocated ₹1,200 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

This allocation reflects the government’s commitment to improving maternal health.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance healthcare services in the state.

The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana also emphasizes the importance of antenatal care.

Pregnant women are encouraged to attend regular check-ups.

These check-ups are crucial for monitoring the health of both the mother and the child.

The scheme also promotes awareness about safe childbirth practices.

Educational programs are conducted to inform women about the benefits of institutional deliveries.

The government collaborates with various NGOs to spread awareness about the scheme.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the implementation of the scheme.

The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is a crucial step towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals.

It aligns with Goal 3 which aims to ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.

The scheme has been instrumental in reducing the maternal mortality ratio in Madhya Pradesh.

According to the latest data, the maternal mortality ratio has decreased by 30 percent since the launch of the scheme.

The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana also plays a role in empowering women.

By providing financial assistance, it reduces the economic burden on families.

This allows women to focus on their health and well-being during pregnancy.

The scheme has also encouraged families to prioritize healthcare.

It has led to an increase in the number of women seeking medical assistance during pregnancy.

The government continues to monitor the scheme's effectiveness.

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the objectives are being met.

The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is a vital component of the state's healthcare strategy.

It reflects the government's commitment to improving maternal and child health outcomes.

The scheme has garnered positive feedback from beneficiaries.

Many women have expressed gratitude for the financial support provided.

This assistance has enabled them to access better healthcare services.

The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is an example of targeted welfare initiatives in India.

It highlights the importance of government intervention in healthcare.

Through this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government aims to create a healthier future for women and children.

The initiative is a testament to the government's focus on social welfare.

It underscores the need for continuous support for vulnerable populations.

The Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is a model that other states can consider replicating.

The scheme is a step towards achieving gender equality in healthcare access.

Overall, it is a comprehensive welfare initiative that addresses critical health issues in the state.
